## Remarks

An uploaded file encodes as its `uploadId` only; its `expiresAt` must be a valid `Date` but is not sent, because the service is authoritative for expiry. Decoding admits only caller-owned files: upload handles are resolved by the service from the wire form, so decoding one fails.
